clips.title: The story
paras: Wolf Heart Sample is bound for the Crossroads, carrying diseased wolf tissue from Lordaeron to Kalimdor. The Royal Apothecary Society seeks to learn what northern toxins do to the Barrens’ native beasts.

Wolf Heart Sample began with plagued wolves in Lordaeron’s ruins. Apothecary Renferrel gathered the hearts, and they were packed for the journey across the Great Sea. The Forsaken’s Royal Apothecary Society seeks greater knowledge of venom, blights, and biological reagents. A courier carries the parcel to the Crossroads in the Barrens, linking Undercity’s experiments in the scarred Eastern Kingdoms with Kalimdor’s frontier outposts.

At the Crossroads, Apothecary Helbrim receives Wolf Heart Sample. Helbrim studies how toxins from Lordaeron’s Scourge-ravaged lands affect the native wildlife of Kalimdor. The toxicity preserved in the wolf hearts may reveal properties that can improve Forsaken poisons and elixirs far from home.
